narrativeProgression.description: The woman is asked if she ever wishes she could put away her singing career like a violin in its case.
She reflects on how her life might be different if she were not a singer, mentioning the disco era.
She explains that she missed out on the disco era due to dedicating her time to practicing and learning her repertoire.
She expresses gratitude for missing the disco era as her focus on singing was more important.
She acknowledges the sacrifices involved in being a singer but emphasizes that it is a gift, not a burden.
She concludes that the positive aspects of her career far outweigh any negatives.
